Why Actual?

Four ideas that shape every decision in the library.

Semantic

Native elements, meaningful classes. HTML you can read, extend and make your own.

No build

Link a stylesheet and start building. Add the script when you need richer interactions.

Progressive

Start with the browser. Layer on dialogs, flyouts, tooltips and tabs as you need them.

Themable

Light, dark and distinctly yours. One token contract connects every component.

The details make the difference

Built on the browser. Ready for more.

A menu when you need an action. A drawer when you need room. A dialog when it matters.

    One install or one link. The rest is yours.

    Choose your starting point

    Add Actual to your project with your package manager.

    npm install actual-css

    Or link it directly in your HTML. No tooling required.

    <link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/actual-css/dist/actual.full.min.css">
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/actual-css/dist/actual.full.js" defer></script>
    Start building View on GitHub
